name: Ankle Mobility Rock
start: half-kneeling facing a wall, front foot planted a few inches away
end: front knee driven forward to touch the wall, heel staying flat on the floor
form: heel stays down, knee tracks over the toes

name: Archer Push-Up
camera: side view, camera low near floor level
start: wide push-up position, arms extended, hands far apart
end: chest lowered toward one bent arm, opposite arm straight and extended out to the side
form: one arm works, the other stays straight

name: Bear Crawl
camera: side view, camera low near floor level
start: quadruped start, knees hovering just off the floor, flat back
end: crawling forward, opposite hand and foot advanced, hips low and level
form: knees hover, hips stay low, no rocking

name: Bench Press
start: lying on the flat bench, eyes under the bar, barbell pressed up over the chest with arms locked out, grip slightly wider than shoulders
end: barbell lowered under control to mid-chest, elbows about 45 degrees from the torso, feet planted
form: shoulder blades squeezed together, bar travels in a slight arc

name: Bench Dip
start: hands on bench edge behind hips, arms straight, hips off the bench, legs extended
end: elbows bent straight back to about 90°, hips lowered toward the floor
form: elbows point back, chest stays up

name: Stationary Bike
start: seated upright on the bike, hands on the handlebars, one pedal at the top of the stroke
end: pedals rotated half a turn, the other leg now pressing down, steady upright posture
form: push through the whole pedal stroke, relaxed shoulders

name: Bird Dog
camera: side view, camera low near floor level
start: on hands and knees, flat back, neutral spine
end: the arm and the leg on OPPOSITE sides are extended: the arm nearest the camera and the knee farthest from the camera stay on the floor, the far arm reaches straight forward and the near leg extends straight back, both level with the back
form: never extend the arm and the leg on the same side; no arching, reach long and stable

name: Bodyweight Good Morning
start: standing tall, hands crossed on chest, soft knees
end: torso hinged forward to near parallel with the floor, hips pushed back, flat spine
form: hips travel back, flat long spine, hinge not squat

name: Bodyweight Squat
start: standing tall, feet shoulder-width, arms forward for balance
end: deep squat, thighs parallel to floor, chest up, knees tracking over toes
form: sit back and down, heels down

name: Butt Kicks
start: standing tall, beginning the movement
end: one heel flicked up toward the glute, knee pointing down, on the ball of the opposite foot
form: heels to glutes, stay light and quick

name: Standing Calf Raise
start: standing flat, feet together, heels down
end: up on the balls of the feet, heels raised high, calves contracted
form: rise fully, pause at top, slow lower

name: Child's Pose
camera: side view, camera low near floor level
start: kneeling upright, about to fold forward
end: hips sitting back on the heels, torso folded forward, arms reaching out front, forehead near the floor
form: sit back on heels, relax and breathe

name: Flexed-Arm Hang
start: holding the TOP position: underhand grip with palms facing the face, chin above the bar, elbows fully bent, chest up
end: the exact same top position held a few seconds later — this is a static hold, NOT a pull-up and NOT a dead hang
form: both panels show chin above the bar; no arrow, only a small white dashed circle around the elbows to show the hold

name: Clap Push-Up
camera: side view, camera low near floor level
start: bottom of a push-up, chest near floor, elbows bent
end: airborne with hands clapped together off the floor, body still rigid
form: explode up, clap, land soft on bent elbows

name: Decline Close-Grip Push-Up
camera: side view, camera low near floor level
start: feet on a raised surface, hands close under the chest, arms extended, body straight and angled down
end: chest lowered, elbows tucked tight to the ribs
form: hands close, elbows back, feet elevated

name: Cobra Stretch
camera: side view, camera low near floor level
start: lying face down, hands under shoulders, chest on the floor
end: chest lifted, gentle back extension, hips staying on the floor, shoulders down
form: lift through the chest, hips stay down

name: Cossack Squat
start: very wide stance, standing tall, toes slightly out
end: deep squat over one bent leg, other leg fully straight with heel down and toes up, torso upright
form: sit deep on one side, opposite leg straight

name: Biceps Curl
start: standing tall, dumbbells hanging at the sides, arms straight, palms facing forward
end: dumbbells curled up to shoulder height, elbows still pinned to the sides
form: elbows stay glued to the sides, no swinging

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
start: lying on bench, dumbbells at chest level, elbows down and out
end: dumbbells pressed up over the chest, arms extended, dumbbells close together
form: shoulder blades retracted, deep stretch at bottom

name: Deadlift
start: hinged over the barbell, mid-foot under the bar, gripping just outside the legs, flat back, chest up
end: standing fully upright at lockout, bar resting at the thighs, hips and knees extended
form: flat back, bar stays close to the legs the whole way

name: Kneeling Diamond Push-Up
camera: side view, camera low near floor level
start: kneeling plank, hands together in a diamond under chest, arms extended, body straight from knees
end: chest lowered to hands, elbows tucked back along the ribs
form: elbows brush ribs, hands form a diamond

name: Parallel Bar Dip
start: supported on the parallel bars with straight arms, body upright, legs slightly bent behind
end: lowered until the upper arms are parallel to the floor, elbows bent back, slight forward lean
form: controlled descent, shoulders stay down

name: Doorway Row
start: feet planted close to the base of the door frame, both hands gripping the frame edges at chest height, arms straight, body straight and leaning BACKWARD away from the doorway at about 45 degrees
end: chest pulled forward to the frame, elbows bent and driven back, body still straight
form: this is a row: the body leans back away from the door, never forward into it like a push-up

name: Downward Dog
start: hands and knees, toes tucked, preparing to lift
end: full inverted V shape, hips high, legs straight, heels reaching toward floor, spine long
form: hips up and back, long spine, chest toward thighs

name: Fire Hydrant
start: on hands and knees, neutral spine, knees under hips
end: one knee lifted straight out to the SIDE (not backward), knee still bent at 90 degrees, thigh roughly parallel to the floor, shin parallel to the floor, like a dog at a hydrant
form: the knee stays bent at 90 degrees the whole time; the leg moves sideways, never kicked back

name: Flutter Kicks
camera: side view, camera low near floor level
start: lying on back, both legs straight and hovering low off the floor
end: legs alternating, one kicked slightly up and one slightly down, lower back pressed to floor
form: small quick kicks, low back stays down

name: Quadruped Glute Kickback
camera: side view, camera low near floor level
start: on hands and knees, flat back, one knee bent under hip
end: same leg driven up and back, sole of foot toward ceiling, thigh in line with torso
form: flat back, move only from the hip

name: Heel Touches
start: lying on back, knees bent, feet flat, head and shoulders slightly lifted, torso side-bent to the right, right hand touching the right heel
end: the body in exactly the same place and orientation, torso side-bent to the left, left hand touching the left heel
form: do not mirror or flip the body between panels; shoulders stay lifted, crunch sideways

name: Standing Hip Circle
start: standing tall, one knee lifted in front
end: same knee circled out to the side, hip opening, torso stable
form: big smooth circles, stable torso

name: Wall Hip Hinge
start: standing just in front of a wall, tall posture, soft knees
end: hips pushed straight back tapping the wall, torso hinged forward, flat back
form: hips reach back to wall, not a squat

name: Hip Thrust
start: upper back resting on the side of the bench, padded barbell across the hips, feet flat, hips lowered toward the floor
end: hips driven up until the body forms a straight line from knees to shoulders, knees at 90 degrees
form: squeeze the glutes hard at the top, chin tucked

name: Hollow Rock
camera: side view, camera low near floor level
start: hollow hold, arms overhead, legs low, lower back pressed down, body in a slight banana curve
end: rocked forward on the hips maintaining the same rigid hollow shape
form: keep the banana shape, rock smoothly

name: Inchworm
start: standing hinged forward with hands on the floor near the feet, legs fairly straight
end: hands walked forward into a high plank, body extended straight
form: legs stay fairly straight, controlled walkout

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
start: reclined on incline bench, dumbbells at upper-chest level, elbows down
end: dumbbells pressed up over the collarbones, arms extended
form: press slightly back, upper-chest focus

name: JM Press
start: lying on bench, barbell held with close grip, arms extended over the chest
end: bar lowered toward the upper neck, elbows forward, forearms near the biceps
form: elbows travel forward, hybrid of press and skull crusher

name: Jumping Lunge
start: bottom of a lunge, back knee low, arms loaded, about to jump
end: airborne at peak, legs switching positions midair, arms driving
form: soft landing, explode straight up, control each rep

name: Squat Jack
start: standing with feet together, hands at chest
end: feet jumped out wide into a squat, hips back, chest up
form: land in a squat, chest up, steady rhythm

name: Kettlebell Clean
start: hinge position, kettlebell hanging between the legs, hips back
end: kettlebell racked at the shoulder, elbow tucked, bell resting on the forearm, standing tall
form: hip drive, keep the bell close

name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
start: standing tall, kettlebell held at the chest by the horns
end: deep squat, thighs parallel, elbows inside the knees, torso upright
form: chest tall, full depth, drive through heels

name: Kettlebell High Pull
start: hinge position, kettlebell hanging between the legs
end: bell pulled up to chest height with the elbow high and back, hips fully extended
form: hip drive powers it, elbow leads high

name: Kettlebell Snatch
start: hinge, kettlebell hanging in one hand between the legs
end: kettlebell locked out overhead, arm straight, bell resting on the back of the forearm, body upright
form: hip drive, punch up through the bell; kettlebell held by the handle with the bell hanging behind the wrist, resting on the back of the forearm — never balanced bottom-up above the fist

name: Kneeling Push-Up
camera: side view, camera low near floor level
start: kneeling plank, hands slightly wider than shoulders, arms extended, straight line from knees to head
end: chest lowered toward floor, elbows at 45°
form: straight body from knees, full chest range

name: Lateral Shuffle
start: low athletic stance, knees bent, weight on one leg about to push off
end: shuffled sideways, feet apart, staying low, chest up
form: stay low, feet don't cross, push off trailing leg

name: Leg Press
start: seated in the machine, back flat on the pad, feet shoulder-width on the platform, legs extended without locking the knees
end: platform lowered until the knees reach 90 degrees, lower back still pressed into the pad
form: lower back stays on the pad, knees track over the toes

name: Leg Swings
start: standing tall holding a wall, leg at the back of the swing
end: same leg swung forward to the front, torso staying upright
form: torso stays tall, leg swings freely

name: Forward Lunge
start: standing tall, feet hip-width, hands on the hips
end: stepped forward into a lunge, front thigh parallel to the floor, back knee just above the floor, torso upright
form: front knee stays over the front foot, back knee drops straight down

name: Machine Chest Press
start: seated at machine, handles at mid-chest, elbows back
end: handles pressed forward, arms extended, chest contracted
form: seat set to mid-chest, controlled return

name: Landmine Row
equipment: barbell anchored in a landmine, weight plates
start: staggered stance, hinged over, one hand gripping the loaded barbell end, arm extended
end: bar end rowed up along the side, elbow high, lat contracted
form: staggered stance, pull along the body

name: Medicine Ball Slam
start: standing tall, medicine ball raised overhead, body fully extended
end: ball slammed down to the floor, torso hinged forward, arms following through
form: full-body extension, slam hard through the core

name: Neck Stretch
start: sitting tall, head neutral, shoulders relaxed
end: head gently tilted toward one shoulder, opposite side of the neck stretched, shoulders down
form: slow and gentle, never force

name: Negative Pull-Up
start: at the top of a pull-up, chin above the bar, arms bent
end: slowly lowering, arms extending, body descending under control toward a full hang
form: 3-5 second slow descent, fight gravity

name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
equipment: pull-up bar with parallel neutral-grip handles
start: dead hang, palms facing each other, arms extended
end: chest pulled up to the handles, elbows down and close to the body
form: elbows drive down, chest to the bar

name: Overhead Press
start: standing, barbell held at shoulder height on the front of the shoulders, elbows slightly in front
end: barbell pressed straight overhead to lockout, ears between the arms, body upright
form: brace the core and glutes, press in a straight vertical line

name: Overhead Dumbbell Extension
start: one dumbbell held overhead with both hands, arms fully extended, elbows in
end: dumbbell lowered behind the head, elbows bent and pointing forward
form: elbows tucked, only forearms move

name: Pendlay Row
start: hinged over, torso parallel to floor, arms straight gripping the bar on the ground
end: bar pulled explosively to the lower chest, elbows back, torso staying parallel
form: reset on floor each rep, flat back

name: Pigeon Stretch
start: front shin brought forward across the body, back leg extended straight behind, torso upright
end: torso folded forward over the front shin, hips square and lowered
form: hips square, sink and fold forward

name: Elevated Pike Push-Up
start: pike position, feet on box, hips high, arms extended, shoulders over hands
end: head lowered between the hands toward the floor, elbows bent
form: hips stay high, shoulders stack over hands

name: Plank Arm Reach
camera: side view, camera low near floor level
start: high plank, both hands down, body straight
end: one arm extended straight forward, hips square and level, body stable
form: hips stay square, reach long

name: Plank Shoulder Tap
start: high plank, both hands on floor under shoulders, body straight
end: one hand lifted tapping the opposite shoulder, hips held square and level
form: no hip rock, keep hips square

name: Up-Down Plank
camera: side view, camera low near floor level
start: forearm plank, body straight
end: high plank on both hands, hips level
form: minimal hip rock, alternate lead arm

name: Preacher Curl
start: seated at preacher bench, arms extended down the pad holding the weight
end: weight curled up to full bicep contraction, arms still on the pad
form: arms stay glued to the pad, no swinging

name: Prisoner Squat
start: standing, hands clasped behind head, elbows wide, chest up
end: deep squat, elbows still wide, torso upright, thighs parallel
form: elbows wide, chest proud, upright torso

name: Prone Bodyweight Leg Curl
camera: side view, camera low near floor level
start: lying face down, legs straight, hips pressed down
end: heels curled up toward the glutes, hamstrings contracted, hips staying flat
form: pelvis stays down, controlled curl

name: Prone W-Raise
camera: side view, camera low near floor level
start: lying face down, elbows bent at sides forming a W shape, forehead resting down
end: arms and elbows lifted off the floor, shoulder blades squeezed together, elbows staying bent
form: squeeze shoulder blades, keep neck neutral

name: Prone Y-Raise
camera: side view, camera low near floor level
start: lying face down, arms extended overhead in a Y shape, forehead resting down
end: arms lifted off the floor to shoulder height, thumbs up, shoulder blades pulled down and together
form: lift with the upper back, not the lower back

name: Pseudo Planche Push-Up
camera: side view, camera low near floor level
start: push-up position with the hands placed beside the WAIST (not under the chest), fingers pointing back toward the feet, shoulders leaning far forward past the hands
end: lowered with the forward lean maintained, elbows in
form: hands by the hips, fingers back, shoulders stay well ahead of the hands — clearly different from a normal push-up

name: Pull-Up
start: dead hang from the bar, overhand grip slightly wider than shoulders, arms fully straight
end: pulled up until the chin clears the bar, elbows driven down toward the hips, chest up
form: pull the elbows down to the hips, no kipping

name: Push-Up
camera: side view, camera low near floor level
start: high plank, hands slightly wider than shoulders, arms straight, body in a straight line from head to heels
end: chest lowered close to the floor, elbows about 45 degrees from the torso, body still straight
form: rigid straight body, full range of motion

name: Renegade Row
start: high plank on two dumbbells, feet wide, hips square
end: one dumbbell rowed to the ribs, elbow high, balancing on the other hand, hips staying level
form: no hip twist, wide base

name: Reverse Crunch
camera: side view, camera low near floor level
start: lying on back, knees bent at tabletop, hips down, hands beside hips
end: pelvis curled up, hips lifted off floor, knees drawn toward chest
form: lift with pelvic curl, not momentum

name: Reverse Fly
start: hinged forward, dumbbells hanging below the chest, slight elbow bend
end: dumbbells raised out to the sides to shoulder level, shoulder blades squeezed
form: lead with elbows, flat back

name: Barbell Row
start: hinged forward about 45 degrees, neutral spine, barbell hanging at arm's length
end: barbell pulled to the lower chest, elbows driven back, shoulder blades squeezed
form: drive the elbows back, keep the torso still

name: Running
equipment: none, outdoor-style running motion on the gym floor
start: mid-stride with the left foot landing under the hips, right arm swinging forward, upright posture
end: next stride with the right foot landing under the hips, left arm swinging forward
form: land with the foot under the hips, relaxed upright running form

name: Scapular Pull-Up
start: dead hang from bar, arms straight, shoulders shrugged up toward ears
end: shoulders pulled down and back, body lifted slightly, arms still straight, chest raised
form: no elbow bend, only scapular movement

name: Seal Row
start: lying chest-down on bench, arms hanging with weights below
end: weights rowed to the ribs, elbows driven back, chest staying on the bench
form: chest stays down, no momentum

name: Shadow Boxing
start: boxing stance, guard up, feet staggered
end: throwing a cross punch, torso rotated, rear foot pivoted, opposite hand guarding the chin
form: guard up, rotate through the hips, stay mobile

name: Shoulder Pass-Through
start: standing, band held wide in front with straight arms
end: band passed overhead and moving behind the back, arms staying straight
form: arms stay straight, grip wide enough to be pain-free

name: Side Plank Hip Dip
start: forearm side plank, body in a straight diagonal, hip high
end: bottom hip lowered toward the floor without touching, obliques loaded
form: control the dip, drive hip high

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
camera: side view, camera low near floor level
start: lying on back, one knee bent foot flat, other leg extended straight, hips down
end: hips driven high on one leg, body straight from shoulder to extended foot, hips level
form: drive through heel, keep hips even

name: Sled Push
start: gripping the sled posts, body leaned forward, one leg driving
end: mid-drive, powerful stride, back leg fully extended, low forward lean
form: lean in, full leg drive each step

name: Spider Curl
start: chest on incline bench, arms hanging straight down holding dumbbells, palms forward
end: dumbbells curled up, upper arms vertical and still, biceps peaked
form: upper arms stay vertical, no swing

name: Split Squat
start: split stance, one foot forward, standing tall, torso upright
end: lowered straight down, back knee near the floor, front thigh parallel, torso upright
form: drop straight down, front shin vertical

name: Barbell Back Squat
start: standing tall, barbell on the upper back, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out
end: squatted to parallel, hips back and down, chest up, knees tracking over the toes
form: chest up, knees over toes, drive through the whole foot

name: Squat Thrust
start: squat with hands on the floor, feet under the hips
end: feet jumped back into a plank position, body straight, arms extended
form: feet jump straight back, no push-up needed

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
equipment: high cable machine with straight bar
start: standing at a high cable, arms extended overhead gripping the bar, slight forward lean
end: bar swept down to the thighs, arms nearly straight, lats contracted
form: minimal elbow bend, drive with the lats

name: Superman Row
camera: side view, camera low near floor level
start: lying face down, arms extended overhead in a superman position, chest and arms slightly lifted off the floor
end: elbows pulled back toward the ribs like a row, chest lifted, shoulder blades squeezed together, legs relaxed on the floor
form: lift through the upper back, keep the neck long

name: Svend Press
start: standing, two plates pressed together at the chest, elbows in
end: plates pressed straight out in front, arms extended, still squeezed together
form: crush the plates together throughout

name: Under-Table Row
start: lying on the back UNDER the table with the legs under it, the table edge directly above the chest, the head beyond the edge; hands grip the edge directly above the chest, arms straight and vertical, heels on the floor, body straight from heels to shoulders
end: chest pulled up to the table edge, elbows bent and pointing down toward the floor, body still straight
form: hands always above the chest, never behind the head; keep the body in a straight line, no sagging hips

name: Thoracic Rotation
start: lying on the side, knees bent, arms stacked out in front
end: top arm opened across the body toward the floor behind, chest rotated open, knees staying stacked
form: rotate through the upper back, knees pinned

name: Towel Row
equipment: towel looped around a sturdy post
start: leaning back with straight arms gripping a towel looped around the anchor, feet braced
end: body pulled up toward the anchor, elbows driven back, chest to the towel
form: keep body rigid, pull with the back not the arms

name: Overhead Triceps Extension
start: standing, one dumbbell held overhead with both hands, arms fully extended, upper arms beside the head
end: dumbbell lowered behind the head by bending only the elbows, upper arms still vertical
form: upper arms stay still, only the forearms move

name: Tuck Jump
start: slight dip, arms back, about to jump
end: airborne at peak with knees pulled up to the chest, torso upright
form: explode up, snap knees up, land soft

name: Turkish Get-Up
start: lying on the back, one arm pressing a kettlebell straight up
end: standing tall, weight locked out overhead, arm vertical, eyes on the weight
form: eyes on weight, arm stays vertical throughout; kettlebell held by the handle with the bell hanging behind the wrist, resting on the back of the forearm — never balanced bottom-up above the fist

name: Wall Sit March
start: wall sit hold, both feet flat, thighs parallel, back on wall
end: same wall sit but one foot lifted a few inches off the floor, hips level
form: hold 90° knees, lift feet without shifting the torso

name: Wall Triceps Push-Away
start: leaning toward wall, hands close at chest height, arms bent, forehead near wall
end: arms fully extended, body pushed back from wall, elbows tucked in
form: elbows stay tucked, only elbows bend

name: Wall Walk
start: push-up position with feet at the base of a wall, hands far out
end: near-handstand against the wall, feet walked up high, hands walked in close, body vertical
form: braced core, move hands and feet together

name: Zottman Curl
start: standing, dumbbells curled up to the shoulders with palms facing up
end: dumbbells halfway down on the way back with wrists rotated so the palms face down
form: palms up on the way up, palms down on the way down, slow lowering
